fusions.name: Crusted Haymaker
fusions.desc: A swipe that deals 14 damage and knocks the target back 3 tiles. The crust it leaves weighs the target down: it is 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Leaden] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Overgrown Maul
fusions.desc: A two-pawed maul that deals 30 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Against a boss or elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Long Torpor
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 12 seconds, and raises your physical resistance by 10%.

fusions.name: Thickening Hide
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 14, and your armour by 6%.
